source.title: Tuition | Film Connection
source.description: Film Connection keeps costs a fraction of traditional film school tuition. Learn how mentor-based training fits your budget and breaks you into the industry.
source.content:
You want to launch a successful career in the film industry but you don’t want to compromise your financial future in the process. 
Film Connection provides unique, mentor-based programs that are affordable, so you can stay in control of your finances. 
Find out how Film Connection keeps costs affordable across all of our offered audio programs and how we help you stay in control of your finances.
Don’t let the burden of student debt prevent your from pursuing a career in the film industry. Film Connection is here to help make your passion for a music a professional future.
Fill out the form to reach a mentee advisor and learn about your opportunities.
*Not all programs are available in every state. Consult a Mentee Advisor to learn more.
